The dev report was read as input, not as conclusions; every count below is this review's own measurement. No environment variable value is printed anywhere in this record.

### ① Derived judgments

1. File surface. 2. `lint.yml`. The hunk at merge-base lines 1498–1521 removes one comment block (19 lines) and one step (`name: Changeset-deadline census self-test`, `id: changeset-deadline-census-self-test`, `continue-on-error: true`, `run: pnpm check:pm-changeset-deadline-census`) plus its separating blank line, 24 lines, inside job `lint-repo-tooling`. The two neighbours (`Stale-\`finding\` sweep self-test` above, `Governed-merges audit self-test` below) are byte-identical to the merge-base and still adjacent. The head file parses as YAML (15 jobs, 297 steps; main 15 jobs, 298 steps); no `steps.changeset-deadline-census-self-test` reference exists anywhere under `.github/` on the head, so no collector or output read the removed id. Correct, and nothing else in the file moved.
3. `package.json`. One line removed, `"check:pm-changeset-deadline-census": "node scripts/pm/changeset-deadline-census.mjs --self-test"`; the file parses, 203 scripts remain, the alias is absent, the neighbours (`check:pm-board-snapshot`, `check:pm-governed-merges`) are unchanged. Correct.

Nothing under `.claude/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agents/**`, `.github/**`, `scripts/**` (dispatch-gates data, `select-gate-families.sh`, self-test-wired, self-test-workflow-commands, symbol-anchor and file-registry gates) names the file, the alias or the step id. Correct.
5. The census's claim holds on `origin/main` today (dbca3ef0). The same grep over origin/main, excluding the file itself and `docs/audits/**`, returns exactly the lint.yml step (lines 1498, 1517, 1518, 1520) and the package.json alias (line 99): the file's only caller was its own `--self-test` step, nothing imports it, no skill, agent or workflow text names it. The claim in 6586191438 ("nothing runs them but their own --self-test in lint.yml") is correct for this tool; the premise line in 6586287965 is correct.
6. Of the 40 non-zero exits, every one is this container (no `node_modules`, no `dist/`), not the diff: 33 print `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` naming the missing `yaml`, `typescript` or `@typescript-eslint/parser` dependency or the missing build output (closing-keyword-parity, comment-mask-corpus, merged-branch-reaper-outcome, step-collectors, aggregator-roster, ci-filter-parity, cli-command-ids, driver-memory-census, dts-closure, dual-build-cjs-loads, lean-entry-closure, sourcemap-no-sources-content, governed-merges self-test, pnpm-acquisition, required-contexts, shard-attestation, stall-guard-budget, stall-guard-headroom, workflow-status-functions, workflow-context-availability); `check-expected-skips --self-test` and the four `check-type-check-coverage` forms exit 1 on `Cannot find package 'yaml'` / `'typescript'`; `check-self-test-workflow-commands` (exit 1) fails on `release-pending-publish` missing `@changesets/cli`; the live `check-dispatch-gates.mjs` was stopped by the sweep's 180 s limit (SIGTERM, its self-test exited 0). step-collectors, self-test-workflow-commands, expected-skips and type-check-coverage reproduce with the same first error line on a merge-base worktree in this container. First content line `Part of #29471` with the card number beside zero verbs, and the body's only other issue number (29471) is the same card, so no closing keyword sits next to another open card; the `PR-body guards` check is success. 798 lines, 24 lines, −823/+0, 3 files, 63 derived commands, 4 exit-3 for missing `dist/`: all reproduce here (my sweep adds the yaml/typescript PREREQUISITE class on top because this container has no `node_modules` at all, which the dev's did). `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` are right (no published package, no spec). "Part of" is right: the card closes only on the 30-day net-negative reading, not on T1. Correct.
10. Nothing new on any surface: no gate, no label, no workflow, no register row, no package. The card asked for deletion "in PRs of one family each, with their self-test cases; no behaviour change in the rows that stay": this PR is one family (T1), the self-test goes with the file, and no staying row or tool is touched.

- Dev `open_questions`: none on 6586754220. The census's two questions (6586191438) were answered by the seat in 6586287965 and do not bear on T1.
- Dev deviation (a): no assignee or reviewer on the PR, per the contract. No flag.
- Dev deviation (b): the branch was fast-forwarded to origin/main ff827bcf before the edit, nothing rebased: the merge-base is ff827bcf and the one commit sits on it. Confirmed.
- Independence: PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, commit author Claude; no off-relay author note is owed. The PR thread carries the seat's `Contract-review-claim:` for this head (6586786021) and no other record.
- Tier H: this record does not lift the landing; the maintainer's hand or an authorized approval does.

### ④ Design judgment

Per hits file, against the card's scenario (a report-only tool with no reader costs a self-test on every dispatch touching `scripts/**`; the discipline text gives such an instrument no in-flight work but deletion):

- `.github/workflows/lint.yml`: removing the step whole, with its comment block, is the right cut. The comment block existed only to explain that step (why the live census is report-only and why only its self-test runs here), so leaving it would be prose about a step that no longer exists; the neighbours' blocks are self-contained and untouched. The step was `continue-on-error: true` with no collector reading its outcome, so no job-level logic changes. Holds.
- `package.json`: the alias goes with the step, which is exactly the pairing `check-self-test-wired` enforces in both directions (an alias with no CI step would red; a step with no alias would red). Holds.
- `scripts/pm/changeset-deadline-census.mjs`: deleted whole rather than trimmed. The 2026-09 gate census already rowed it `retire` conditioned on "no other user"; that condition is now measured true on main. Nothing imports it, so no shared helper has to stay. Holds.

Combined status `pending` (statuses API, 0 statuses). The eleven in-progress shards are the full-battery test lanes on a diff that touches no package source; the landing pre-check still owes a read of them green before any Tier H act. `mergeable_state` blocked, draft, `auto_merge` null, labels `ci/cd`, `size/l`, `dependencies`, `skip-changeset`; Tier H (`.github/workflows/**`), landing by the maintainer's hand or an authorized approval, not by this record.
